doc.summary: Operator steering layer for the LazyOwn autonomous daemon.
doc.description:
The daemon (``skills/autonomous_daemon.py``) reads the control state
written here before every command execution. The CLI (``do_daemon_*``)
and MCP (``lazyown_daemon_*``) write the same state. This module owns:

* The data model (:class:`ControlState`, :class:`PendingAction`).
* Atomic persistence to ``sessions/daemon_control.json``.
* The approval-gate state machine and a blocking wait helper.

All public methods are safe for concurrent use across processes
because every write goes through ``tempfile`` + ``os.replace`` so
readers either see the previous file or the new one but never a
truncated file.

doc.summary: A single command awaiting operator approval.

params.name: action_id
params.description: Unique identifier matched by the operator when approving or vetoing.

params.name: command
params.description: Shell command proposed by the daemon.

params.name: reason
params.description: Selector-supplied rationale forwarded to the operator.

params.name: target
params.description: Active target host the command will run against.

params.name: proposed_at
params.description: Epoch seconds when the action was registered.

params.name: ttl_seconds
params.description: How long the action waits before expiring.

params.name: decision
params.description:
One of :data:`DECISION_PENDING`,
:data:`DECISION_APPROVED`, :data:`DECISION_VETOED`,
:data:`DECISION_EXPIRED`.

params.name: decided_at
params.description: Epoch seconds when the decision was recorded (``0.0`` while pending).

params.name: operator
params.description: Identifier of the operator who decided (empty when expired).

signature: def is_expired(self, now: float | None = None) -> bool

doc.summary: Return ``True`` when a still-pending action has exceeded its TTL.
Steering state shared between operator surfaces and the daemon.

params.name: mode
params.description:
One of :data:`MODE_AUTO`, :data:`MODE_APPROVAL`,
:data:`MODE_PAUSED`. Default is auto, which preserves the
historical daemon behaviour.

params.name: vetoed_commands
params.description: First-token names the daemon must avoid.

params.name: focus_targets
params.description: When non-empty, the daemon only executes objectives whose target appears in this list.

params.name: pending
params.description: Active approval request, when ``mode == approval`` and the daemon has proposed a command.

params.name: updated_at
params.description: Epoch seconds of the last write — populated by :meth:`DaemonControl.save`.

signature: def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> ControlState

doc.summary: Build a state from JSON data, sanitising malformed input.
Atomic read/write facade for ``sessions/daemon_control.json``.
doc.description:
All mutations write to a temp file then ``os.replace`` for
atomicity so concurrent readers (daemon + CLI + MCP) never observe
partial JSON. The instance is also safe to share inside one
process: every write is serialised by an internal lock.

doc.summary: Pin the control file to ``<sessions_dir>/daemon_control.json``.

params.name: sessions_dir
params.description:
Absolute or relative path to the LazyOwn
``sessions/`` directory. The directory is created on
the first write if it does not yet exist.

doc.summary: Absolute path of the control file on disk.
Return the current state or defaults when the file is missing.
Persist ``state`` atomically.
doc.description:
The ``updated_at`` field is overwritten with the current epoch
so callers do not need to maintain it.

Convenience wrapper for ``set_mode(MODE_PAUSED)``.

Append a first-token name to the veto list.

Remove every entry from the veto list.

doc.summary: Daemon-side: register a pending action awaiting approval.
doc.description:
Returns the freshly created :class:`PendingAction` whose
``action_id`` the daemon will use when calling
:func:`wait_for_decision` and :meth:`consume`.

signature: def decide(self, action_id: str, decision: str, *, operator: str = '') -> PendingAction | None

doc.summary: Operator-side: approve or veto the pending action.
doc.description:
Returns the updated :class:`PendingAction` or ``None`` when
there is no pending action with the supplied id.

raises.name: ValueError
raises.description: When ``decision`` is not approved or vetoed.

name: consume
signature: def consume(self, action_id: str, *, now: float | None = None) -> PendingAction | None

doc.summary: Daemon-side: read the final decision and clear the slot.
doc.description:
When the action is still pending but has exceeded its TTL the
returned :class:`PendingAction` carries ``decision =
DECISION_EXPIRED``. The pending slot is always cleared so the
daemon can propose a new action on the next step.

params.name: action_id
params.description: Identifier returned by :meth:`propose`.

params.name: now
params.description:
Replaceable wall-clock value, in epoch seconds. When
``None`` (production default) ``time.time()`` is used.
Tests pass an explicit value so expiry can be exercised
deterministically.

doc.summary: Return ``True`` when the daemon must stop before executing.
Return ``True`` when the command's first token is in the veto list.
Return ``True`` when no focus is configured or ``target`` is in focus.

name: wait_for_decision
signature: def wait_for_decision(control: DaemonControl, action: PendingAction, *, poll_interval: float = APPROVAL_POLL_INTERVAL_S, sleep_fn: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep, now_fn: Callable[[], float] = time.time) -> PendingAction

doc.summary: Block until the operator decides or the TTL expires.
doc.description:
The poll interval and clock are injectable so unit tests can drive
the state machine deterministically without sleeping.

params.name: control
params.description: :class:`DaemonControl` instance bound to the same ``sessions/`` directory the operator surfaces use.

params.name: action
params.description: The :class:`PendingAction` previously returned by :meth:`DaemonControl.propose`.

params.name: poll_interval
params.description: Seconds between state polls.

params.name: sleep_fn
params.description: Replaceable ``time.sleep`` for tests.

params.name: now_fn
params.description: Replaceable ``time.time`` for tests.

returns.description:
The final :class:`PendingAction` with ``decision`` set to one
of :data:`DECISION_APPROVED`, :data:`DECISION_VETOED`, or
:data:`DECISION_EXPIRED`.

name: wait_until_unpaused
signature: def wait_until_unpaused(control: DaemonControl, *, poll_interval: float = PAUSE_POLL_INTERVAL_S, sleep_fn: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep, max_wait_seconds: float | None = None, now_fn: Callable[[], float] = time.time) -> bool

doc.summary: Block while the daemon is paused, returning when it resumes.

params.name: control
params.description: :class:`DaemonControl` instance.

params.name: poll_interval
params.description: Seconds between mode checks.

params.name: sleep_fn
params.description: Replaceable ``time.sleep`` for tests.

params.name: max_wait_seconds
params.description: Optional upper bound. ``None`` waits forever.

params.name: now_fn
params.description: Replaceable ``time.time`` for tests.

returns.description:
``True`` when the daemon resumed; ``False`` when
``max_wait_seconds`` elapsed without a resume signal.
